name: agent-fleet
description: 通用多模型子任务执行工具:用 Claude Agent SDK 驱动自主 Agent,给它一个任务和一个模型(Gemini/DeepSeek/Kimi 或任意 Anthropic 兼容端点),bypassPermissions 权限跑到底,支持多任务并发跑不同模型。纯本地工具,不经过任何 Kollab 基础设施。

scripts.security-test: node test/assert-helper.mjs --isolated sh -c "node test/security-unit-test.mjs && node test/security-e2e-test.mjs"
scripts.unit-test: node test/assert-helper.mjs --isolated sh -c "node test/env-precedence-test.mjs && node test/patrol-artifact-test.mjs && node test/requests-test.mjs && node test/wait-any-test.mjs && node test/subscription-routes-test.mjs && node test/gemini-dual-test.mjs && node test/gemini-fallback-e2e-test.mjs && node test/child-park-test.mjs && node test/code-continue-test.mjs && node test/supervision-test.mjs && node test/detach-say-test.mjs && node test/verdict-test.mjs && node test/control-unit-test.mjs && node test/dead-run-test.mjs && node test/shortcuts-test.mjs && node test/failure-report-test.mjs && node test/model-mapping-test.mjs && node test/team-test.mjs && node test/openai-bridge-test.mjs && node test/ledger-test.mjs && node test/timeline-test.mjs && node test/live-progress-test.mjs && node test/sdk-usage-test.mjs && node test/detach-test.mjs"
scripts.test: node test/assert-helper.mjs --isolated sh -c "pnpm run unit-test && pnpm run smoke-test && pnpm run security-test && node test/fleet-go-test.mjs && node test/order-test.mjs && node test/dispatch-examples.mjs && python3 test/redact-test.py && python3 test/mini-test.py && python3 test/status-cache-test.py && python3 test/worktree-test.py && python3 test/clean-test.py && python3 test/watch-busy-test.py && python3 test/watch-bounded-test.py && python3 test/watch-durable-test.py && python3 test/watch-contention-test.py && pnpm run gcp-test"
scripts.check-sdk: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const pkg=require('./package.json');const cur=pkg.dependencies['@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk'];const latest=execSync('npm view @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk version').toString().trim();console.log('package.json 当前: '+cur+'  |  npm 最新: '+latest);"
scripts.gcp-test: node test/gcp-environment-test.mjs && node test/gcp-git-test.mjs && node test/gcp-no-fallback-test.mjs && node test/gcp-report-test.mjs && node test/gcp-runner-integration-test.mjs && node test/gcp-transport-client-test.mjs && node test/gcp-workspace-test.mjs && node test/gcp-control-bridge-test.mjs && python3 test/gcp_pool_plan_test.py && python3 test/gcpx-heavy-test.py && python3 test/gcpx-supervisor-test.py && python3 test/gcpx-test.py && python3 test/gcpx-transport-test.py
